title: Gunmen Attack Balochistan Home Minister's Convoy in Mastung, Seven Injured
detail: Unidentified gunmen ambushed the convoy of Balochistan Home and Tribal Affairs Minister Mir Ziaullah Langove at Kund Umarani in the Khad Koocha area, south of Mastung, as he travelled to Quetta from Kalat after attending an Independence Day ceremony. Security personnel exchanged fire with the attackers for around 20 minutes before they fled. Seven people, including three Anti-Terrorism Force personnel, were injured; the minister was unhurt. No group immediately claimed responsibility, though a Home Department aide alleged the convoy had been targeted by Fitna al-Hindustan (Pakistan's term for India-linked Baloch separatist networks).

title: TTP Rocket and Gun Attack on Bajaur Police Post Kills One Officer
detail: Armed men attacked a police post in the Kohi Sar area of Bajaur district's Barang tehsil in the early hours of Friday, using rocket launchers and small arms in an exchange of fire that lasted several hours. Constable Zahir Shah died of his wounds while being transported to hospital; Head Constable Amir Zada was also wounded but reported out of danger. Police attributed the attack to Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP).
